resolved_findings.detail: Both opt-in triggers rendered the identical desktop label 'Guide me through this'.
resolved_findings.resolution: FIXED in commit 9353a6c. GuidedCorruptionTrigger.tsx now renders the visible desktop label 'Guide me through corruption' (matching its aria-label), differentiating it from GuidedDiseaseTrigger. The disease trigger keeps its visible 'Guide me through this' text (aria-label remains 'Guide me through this disease'). Mobile icon-only behavior and aria-labels unchanged; no test regressions (the corruption trigger test asserts only the aria-label, which was already distinct).

accepted_deviations.detail: Scope bundling / strictly-additive gate: commit 19fe2ab ('fix: guard class-endeavour lookup against prototype-member class names') is on this branch over origin/main and modifies EXISTING pure logic (src/logic/endeavours.ts buildPickerItems, src/logic/assistant/rules/downtime-recommendations.ts downtimeRecommendationSuggestions) plus a PRE-EXISTING test (src/logic/assistant/rules/__tests__/downtime-recommendations.test.ts catalogFor helper). These belong to the prior downtime/endeavour task, not guided disease/corruption.
accepted_deviations.resolution: ACCEPTED as a documented cross-task robustness hotfix, per explicit user decision (option b). The change is a behavior-preserving Object.hasOwn prototype-pollution guard that fixes a real '__proto__'-as-class-name crash; valid classes are unaffected and the change is test-backed. The user explicitly declined history rewriting on the shared main branch (option a) as not worth the risk. The diff scope is therefore documented-but-additive: this commit is recorded here as an accepted deviation rather than a blocker, and the guided disease/corruption feature code itself remains strictly additive (one opt-in trigger per CorruptionCard and per rendered active-disease row; no forking of diseases.ts/corruption.ts/mutation-tables.ts/assistant rules).
